verdict.rationale: ADK's official docs include a guide for exposing ADK tools via an MCP server that any MCP client can connect to, showing the framework supports the server-side role, not just client-side consumption. However this is a build-your-own guide rather than a fully managed/hosted 'official' MCP server, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of external clients connecting successfully. Missing for 10: a first-party hosted/managed MCP server endpoint, and independent verification of external MCP client connectivity.
